[[File:Kampioen van Nederland Eredivisie KNVB 2023-2024.png|thumb|200px|Imitation of the 2023–24 championship bowl]]
The '''Dutch football champions''' are the winners of the highest league in Dutch football, which since 1956 is the [[Eredivisie]].

The championship was first awarded in 1898. Until 1954 the national champion was determined by means of a championship competition between the champions of the different regions. This system continued for two years after the introduction of professional football in 1954 until the creation of the [[Eredivisie]] for the [[1956–57 Eredivisie|1956–57]] season. Starting with the [[1956–57 Eredivisie|1956–57]] season, the winner of the [[Eredivisie]] is recognized as the national champion.<ref name="historie eredivisie">{{cite web|url=https://www.knvb.nl/competities/eredivisie/historie|title=Historie VriendenLoterij Eredivisie|website=KNVB.nl|language=nl|access-date=28 December 2025}}</ref>
